title: Suburbia is Subsidized: Here's the Math [ST07]
summary: Not Just Bikes explains, using Urban3's property-tax analysis, why car-dependent suburbs generate less tax revenue than they cost to maintain, so dense urban cores effectively subsidize them. It is part of a Strong Towns series.
why: The go-to link in urban planning threads for the claim that suburban infrastructure costs more per resident than it pays back.

quote.text: Good overview of the research on this
